lines.explanation: the keyword import is used to import classes from packages. It allows you to refer to a class of a package by its class name, without the package prefix. This line, we imported all the classes from edu.pitt.sis.is17 package.
if you want to use a class from a package, you can refer to it by using the full name(package name plus class name). This line imports the ArrayList class from java.util package.
